tooltip.eesmp.shard_of_life: ...and this shard was forged with my blood.
tooltip.eesmp.shard_of_death: I had to watch all my friends die...
tooltip.eesmp.heart_of_irellia: I watched the world die as my heart was forged in blood.
tooltip.eesmp.shard_of_dreams: Within my dreams I asked myself...
tooltip.eesmp.heart_of_reality: I gave my life for the world, yet I still feel I've failed it.
tooltip.eesmp.shard_of_time: ...and yet I could not find you.
tooltip.eesmp.shard_of_space: I searched for you in a space between time...
tooltip.eesmp.heart_of_zuelia: I failed to find you at the edge of the universe despite my endless search.
